def copy_verified(
    source: Path,
    destination: Path,
    copy_rows: list[dict],
    source_label: str,
) -> None:
    if not source.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(source)
    if destination.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"拒绝覆盖已存在目标：{destination}")
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
    source_size = source.stat().st_size
    destination_size = destination.stat().st_size
    source_hash = sha256_file(source)
    destination_hash = sha256_file(destination)
    matched = source_size == destination_size and source_hash == destination_hash
    copy_rows.append(
        {
            "source_label": source_label,
            "source": source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "destination": destination.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "source_size": source_size,
            "destination_size": destination_size,
            "source_sha256": source_hash,
            "destination_sha256": destination_hash,
            "matched": matched,
        }
    )
    if not matched:
        raise RuntimeError(f"字节级复制校验失败：{destination}")

        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (

                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        if not checksum_path.exists():

            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(

        if not reusable:

            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (

                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",

                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,

                )

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",

                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

def workbook_rows(path: Path, sheet: str | int = 0) -> tuple[int, list[str], list[dict]]:
    workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    worksheet = workbook[workbook.sheetnames[sheet] if isinstance(sheet, int) else sheet]
    worksheet.reset_dimensions()
    raw_rows = list(worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    workbook.close()
    header_index = None
    best_nonblank = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(raw_rows[:20]):
        nonblank = sum(value is not None for value in row)
        if nonblank > best_nonblank:
            best_nonblank = nonblank
            header_index = index
    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

def load_inputs(self) -> None:
        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")

def workbook_rows(path: Path, sheet: str | int = 0) -> tuple[int, list[str], list[dict]]:
    workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    worksheet = workbook[workbook.sheetnames[sheet] if isinstance(sheet, int) else sheet]
    worksheet.reset_dimensions()
    raw_rows = list(worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    workbook.close()
    header_index = None
    best_nonblank = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(raw_rows[:20]):
        nonblank = sum(value is not None for value in row)
        if nonblank > best_nonblank:
            best_nonblank = nonblank
            header_index = index
    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

            manifest_row = {

                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:

                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {

                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

def workbook_rows(path: Path, sheet: str | int = 0) -> tuple[int, list[str], list[dict]]:
    workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    worksheet = workbook[workbook.sheetnames[sheet] if isinstance(sheet, int) else sheet]
    worksheet.reset_dimensions()
    raw_rows = list(worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    workbook.close()
    header_index = None
    best_nonblank = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(raw_rows[:20]):
        nonblank = sum(value is not None for value in row)
        if nonblank > best_nonblank:
            best_nonblank = nonblank
            header_index = index
    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

def load_inputs(self) -> None:
        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")

def workbook_rows(path: Path, sheet: str | int = 0) -> tuple[int, list[str], list[dict]]:
    workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    worksheet = workbook[workbook.sheetnames[sheet] if isinstance(sheet, int) else sheet]
    worksheet.reset_dimensions()
    raw_rows = list(worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    workbook.close()
    header_index = None
    best_nonblank = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(raw_rows[:20]):
        nonblank = sum(value is not None for value in row)
        if nonblank > best_nonblank:
            best_nonblank = nonblank
            header_index = index
    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

def load_inputs(self) -> None:
        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")
