        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

    raw_rows = list(worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    workbook.close()
    header_index = None
    best_nonblank = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(raw_rows[:20]):
        nonblank = sum(value is not None for value in row)
        if nonblank > best_nonblank:
            best_nonblank = nonblank
            header_index = index
    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

        for item in INPUTS:

            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")

    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

def copy_verified(
    source: Path,
    destination: Path,
    copy_rows: list[dict],
    source_label: str,
) -> None:
    if not source.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(source)
    if destination.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"拒绝覆盖已存在目标：{destination}")
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
    source_size = source.stat().st_size
    destination_size = destination.stat().st_size
    source_hash = sha256_file(source)
    destination_hash = sha256_file(destination)
    matched = source_size == destination_size and source_hash == destination_hash
    copy_rows.append(
        {
            "source_label": source_label,
            "source": source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "destination": destination.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "source_size": source_size,
            "destination_size": destination_size,
            "source_sha256": source_hash,
            "destination_sha256": destination_hash,
            "matched": matched,
        }
    )
    if not matched:
        raise RuntimeError(f"字节级复制校验失败：{destination}")

        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

for index, req in enumerate(reqs, 1):
        dtype = req["data_type"]
        zip_path = ZIP_DIR / dtype / req["expected_filename"]
        checksum_path = CHECKSUM_DIR / dtype / (req["expected_filename"] + ".CHECKSUM")
        checksum_part = checksum_path.with_name(checksum_path.name + ".part")
        zip_part = zip_path.with_name(zip_path.name + ".part")
        expected_size = int(head_by[(req["requirement_id"], "ZIP")]["content_length"])

        if not checksum_path.exists():
            log(f"CHECKSUM_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_checksum_url"], checksum_part, None, False)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if last["exit_code"] != 0 or last["http_status"] != 200 or last["final_url"] != req["expected_checksum_url"]:
                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)
        official_bytes = checksum_path.read_bytes()
        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:
                try:
                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                        and verified["local_zip_sha256"] == official_sha
                    )
                except FormalBlock:
                    reusable = False
            if not reusable:
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "EXISTING_H0F_ZIP_NOT_REUSABLE",
                    "H0-F目录内同名ZIP不满足全部复用条件；为防覆盖已停止",
                    {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "zip_path": str(zip_path)},
                )
        if not reusable:
            log(f"ZIP_GET {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']} expected_bytes={expected_size}")
            attempts = download_with_retries(req["expected_official_zip_url"], zip_part, expected_size, True)
            last = attempts[-1]
            if (
                last["exit_code"] != 0
                or last["http_status"] not in {200, 206}
                or last["final_url"] != req["expected_official_zip_url"]
                or not zip_part.exists()
                or zip_part.stat().st_size != expected_size
            ):
                raise FormalBlock(
                    "ZIP_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE",
                    "ZIP下载失败或最终字节数不符",
                    {
                        "requirement_id": req["requirement_id"],
                        "expected_content_length": expected_size,
                        "actual_part_size": zip_part.stat().st_size if zip_part.exists() else 0,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                    },
                )
            os.replace(zip_part, zip_path)

        log(f"ZIP_VERIFY {index}/183 {req['requirement_id']}")
        verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)

                raise FormalBlock("CHECKSUM_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE", "官方CHECKSUM下载失败", {"requirement_id": req["requirement_id"], "attempts": attempts})
            os.replace(checksum_part, checksum_path)

        official_sha = parse_official_checksum(official_bytes, req["expected_filename"])

        reusable = False
        if zip_path.exists():
            if zip_path.stat().st_size == expected_size:

                    cached_row = cached.get(req["requirement_id"], {})
                    verified = verify_zip(req, zip_path, official_sha)
                    reusable = (
                        cached_row.get("zip_url", req["expected_official_zip_url"]) == req["expected_official_zip_url"]

            if (

def copy_verified(
    source: Path,
    destination: Path,
    copy_rows: list[dict],
    source_label: str,
) -> None:
    if not source.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(source)
    if destination.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"拒绝覆盖已存在目标：{destination}")
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(source, destination)

def read_simple_sheet(path: Path, sheet: str) -> list[dict]:
    wb = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    ws = wb[sheet]
    rows = ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)
    header = list(next(rows))
    result = [dict(zip(header, row)) for row in rows if any(v is not None for v in row)]
    wb.close()
    return result

def previous_same_symbol_end(
    cycle: dict[str, Any],
    cycles_by_symbol: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
) -> datetime | None:
    start = parse_dt(cycle.get("start_time"))
    previous: datetime | None = None
    for other in cycles_by_symbol[text(cycle.get("symbol"))]:
        other_end = parse_dt(other.get("end_time"))
        if other_end is not None and start is not None and other_end <= start:
            if text(other.get("tid")) != text(cycle.get("tid")):
                previous = other_end
    return previous


def connected_pre_open_attempts(
    cycle: dict[str, Any],
    base_orders: list[dict[str, str]],
    cycles_by_symbol: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
    direct_ids: set[str],
) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    start = parse_dt(cycle.get("start_time"))
    if start is None:
        return []
    previous_end = previous_same_symbol_end(cycle, cycles_by_symbol)
    candidates: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    for order in base_orders:
        created = parse_dt(order.get("北京时间"))
        ended = parse_dt(order.get("结束或更新时间")) or created
        if (
            order.get("合约") == text(cycle.get("symbol"))
            and normalize_id(order.get("主标识")) not in direct_ids
            and decimal_value(order.get("实际成交数量")) == 0
            and created is not None
            and created <= start
            and (previous_end is None or created >= previous_end)
            and order.get("最终状态", "").upper()
            in {"CANCELED", "CANCELLED", "EXPIRED", "REJECTED"}
        ):
            enriched = dict(order)
            enriched["__created"] = created  # type: ignore[assignment]
            enriched["__ended"] = ended  # type: ignore[assignment]
            candidates.append(enriched)
    candidates.sort(key=lambda row: row["__created"])  # type: ignore[index]
    connected: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    anchor = start
    for order in reversed(candidates):
        ended = order["__ended"]  # type: ignore[index]
        created = order["__created"]  # type: ignore[index]
        gap = anchor - ended if ended <= anchor else timedelta(0)
        if gap <= timedelta(hours=2):
            connected.append(order)
            anchor = min(anchor, created)
        elif connected:
            break
    connected.reverse()
    for order in connected:
        order.pop("__created", None)
        order.pop("__ended", None)
    return connected

        for order in tid_orders:
            events.append(direct_order_event(order))

        holding_candidates: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        residual_candidates: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        for order in base_orders:
            created = parse_dt(order.get("北京时间"))
            ended = parse_dt(order.get("结束或更新时间")) or created
            order_id = normalize_id(order.get("主标识"))
            if (
                order.get("合约") != symbol
                or order_id in direct_ids
                or decimal_value(order.get("实际成交数量")) != 0
                or created is None
                or start is None
                or end is None
                or not (start <= created <= end)
            ):
                continue
            if ended is not None and ended > end:
                residual_candidates.append(order)
            else:
                holding_candidates.append(order)

        for order in holding_candidates:
            active = [
                other
                for other in cycles
                if text(other.get("symbol")) == symbol
                and (parse_dt(other.get("start_time")) or datetime.max)
                <= (parse_dt(order.get("北京时间")) or datetime.min)
                <= (parse_dt(other.get("end_time")) or datetime.min)
            ]
            confidence = "B" if len(active) == 1 else "C"
            events.append(
                unfilled_order_event(
                    order,
                    cycle,
                    tid_orders,
                    "B｜持仓期间操作链",
                    confidence,
                )
            )
        for order in residual_candidates:
            active = [
                other
                for other in cycles
                if text(other.get("symbol")) == symbol
                and (parse_dt(other.get("start_time")) or datetime.max)
                <= (parse_dt(order.get("北京时间")) or datetime.min)
                <= (parse_dt(other.get("end_time")) or datetime.min)
            ]
            confidence = "B" if len(active) == 1 else "C"
            events.append(
                residual_order_event(order, cycle, tid_orders, confidence)
            )
            residual_event_count += 1

        for condition, confidence in condition_candidates_for_cycle(
            cycle, conditions, cycles
        ):
            condition_row = condition_event(
                condition, cycle, tid_orders, confidence
            )
            events.append(condition_row)
            if condition_row["阶段区间"].startswith("C"):
                residual_event_count += 1

        tid_events = events[before_count:]
        segments = {event["阶段区间"][0] for event in tid_events}
        if "A" not in segments:
            events.append(
                segment_check_event(
                    cycle,

def copy_verified(
    source: Path,
    destination: Path,
    copy_rows: list[dict],
    source_label: str,
) -> None:
    if not source.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(source)
    if destination.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"拒绝覆盖已存在目标：{destination}")
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
    source_size = source.stat().st_size
    destination_size = destination.stat().st_size
    source_hash = sha256_file(source)
    destination_hash = sha256_file(destination)
    matched = source_size == destination_size and source_hash == destination_hash
    copy_rows.append(
        {
            "source_label": source_label,
            "source": source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "destination": destination.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "source_size": source_size,
            "destination_size": destination_size,
            "source_sha256": source_hash,
            "destination_sha256": destination_hash,
            "matched": matched,
        }
    )
    if not matched:
        raise RuntimeError(f"字节级复制校验失败：{destination}")

    time_matches = re.findall(r"2026-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}", critical_text)
    raw_time_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith("2026-")]
    quantity_candidates = [line for line in lines if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.\d+", line)]

    if not algorithm_match or not contract_match or not trigger_match:
        raise RuntimeError(f"关键字段解析失败：{image_id} {critical_text!r}")
    algorithm_id = algorithm_match.group(1)
    contract = contract_match.group(0)
    compare_symbol = trigger_match.group(1)
    trigger_price_raw = trigger_match.group(2)
    trigger_price = decimal_text(trigger_price_raw)

    correction = VISUAL_CORRECTIONS.get(image_id, {})
    if correction.get("create_time"):
        create_time = correction["create_time"]
        terminal_time = time_matches[-1]
        visual_corrections.append({"image_internal_id": image_id, "field": "创建时间", "ocr_raw": raw_time_lines[0] if raw_time_lines else "", "corrected": create_time, "reason": correction["reason"]})
    else:
        if len(time_matches) != 2:
            raise RuntimeError(f"时间解析失败：{image_id} {critical_text!r}")
        create_time, terminal_time = time_matches

    quantity_raw = quantity_candidates[0] if quantity_candidates else ""
    if correction.get("quantity"):
        quantity_raw = correction["quantity"]
        visual_corrections.append({"image_internal_id": image_id, "field": "数量", "ocr_raw": "", "corrected": quantity_raw, "reason": correction["reason"]})
    quantity_standard = decimal_text(quantity_raw) if quantity_raw else None

    classified = state_classification[image_id]
    actual_status = classified["actual_status"]
    key = (create_time, contract, actual_status, compare_symbol, trigger_price)
    candidates = mother_index.get(key, [])
    if len(candidates) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"复合指纹非唯一：{image_id} key={key} candidates={len(candidates)}")
    mother = candidates[0]

    nature = str(mother.get("止盈/止损性质") or "")
    if nature == "止盈型":
        condition_type = "市价止盈"
    elif nature == "止损型":
        condition_type = "市价止损"
    else:
        raw_type = compact(ocr["focused"]["type"]["text"])
        condition_type = "市价止盈" if "止盈" in raw_type else "市价止损" if "止损" in raw_type else "无法确认"
    close_direction = str(mother["平仓方向"])

def process_all_datasets(
    rules: dict[str, Any],
    duplicate_snapshot: dict[str, Any],
    validation: dict[str, Any],
    start_hashes: dict[str, Any],
    run_timestamp: str,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], RunMetrics, dict[str, Any]]:
    metrics = RunMetrics()
    original = read_original_records(rules)
    source_sha = {
        row["相对路径"]: row["SHA256"] for row in start_hashes["files"]
    }
    expected = expected_records_by_sheet(duplicate_snapshot)
    for key, expected_count in expected.items():
        actual_count = len(original[key])
        if actual_count != expected_count:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Effective region mismatch {key}: {actual_count} != {expected_count}"
            )

    dataset_rows: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    count_by_sheet: collections.Counter[tuple[str, str]] = collections.Counter()

    for sheet_name in (
        "30天交易复盘明细",
        "资金变动记录",
        "复盘说明与字段定义",
    ):
        file_name = SOURCE_FILES["manual"]
        for row in original[(file_name, sheet_name)]:
            dataset_rows["manual"].append(
                manual_record(
                    row,
                    sheet_name,
                    source_sha[file_name],
                    run_timestamp,
                    duplicate_snapshot,
                    metrics,
                )
            )
            count_by_sheet[(file_name, sheet_name)] += 1

    processor_specs: list[
        tuple[str, Callable[..., dict[str, Any]]]
    ] = [
        ("orders", orders_record),
        ("fills", fills_record),
        ("positions", positions_record),
        ("contract_ledger", contract_ledger_record),
        ("account_ledger", account_ledger_record),
    ]
    for dataset_key, processor in processor_specs:
        file_name = SOURCE_FILES[dataset_key]
        for row in original[(file_name, "Sheet0")]:
            dataset_rows[dataset_key].append(
                processor(
                    row,
                    source_sha[file_name],
                    run_timestamp,
                    duplicate_snapshot,
                    metrics,
                )
            )
            count_by_sheet[(file_name, "Sheet0")] += 1
    screenshots = screenshot_records(start_hashes, run_timestamp, metrics)
    dataset_rows["screenshots"] = screenshots
    count_by_sheet[(SCREENSHOT_DIR_NAME, "账户结单页面（截图伪工作表）")] = len(
        screenshots
    )

    dataset_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for dataset_key in (
        "manual",
        "orders",
        "fills",
        "positions",
        "contract_ledger",
        "account_ledger",
        "screenshots",
    ):
        jsonl_path = WORK_DIR / f"{dataset_key}.jsonl"
        columns, count = write_jsonl(jsonl_path, dataset_rows[dataset_key])
        reconciliation = reconciliation_rows(
            dataset_key,
            count_by_sheet,
            metrics,
            expected,
        )
        if any(row["对账结论"] != "通过" for row in reconciliation):
            raise RuntimeError(f"Record reconciliation failed for {dataset_key}")
        dataset_entries.append(
            {
                "key": dataset_key,
                "title": {
                    "manual": "阶段04｜人工复盘标准化数据",
                    "orders": "阶段04｜合约订单历史标准化数据",
                    "fills": "阶段04｜合约交易历史Fill标准化数据",
                    "positions": "阶段04｜合约仓位历史摘要标准化数据",
                    "contract_ledger": "阶段04｜合约交易流水标准化数据",
                    "account_ledger": "阶段04｜全账户交易流水标准化数据",
                    "screenshots": "阶段04｜账户截图索引标准化数据",
                }[dataset_key],
                "output_path": (DATA_DIR / DATASET_OUTPUTS[dataset_key]).as_posix(),
                "data_jsonl": jsonl_path.as_posix(),
                "data_columns": columns,
                "field_description_rows": field_description_rows(
                    dataset_key,
                    columns,
                    rules,
                ),
                "warnings": metrics.warning_rows[dataset_key],

    temporary_script = WORK_DIR / "04_build_workbooks.mjs"

        if node_modules_link.is_symlink():
            node_modules_link.unlink()
        elif node_modules_link.is_dir():
            shutil.rmtree(node_modules_link)
        else:
            node_modules_link.unlink()

formal_inputs = validate_formal_inputs()
    protected_start = capture_protected_stage_hashes()
    start_hashes = capture_source_hashes("阶段04开始")
    rules, duplicate_snapshot, validation = load_or_create_rule_snapshots()
    if not duplicate_snapshot["verification"]["passed"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Stage03 duplicate/hash snapshot failed verification")

    datasets, metrics, runtime = process_all_datasets(
        rules,
        duplicate_snapshot,
        validation,
        start_hashes,
        run_timestamp,
    )
    # This is the formal end-of-source-reading checkpoint. The artifact builder
    # consumes only Stage04 JSON/JSONL and never opens original sources.
    source_read_end_hashes = capture_source_hashes("阶段04原始资料读取结束")
    hash_rows = compare_source_hashes(start_hashes, source_read_end_hashes)
    if sum(row["复核结论"] == "通过" for row in hash_rows) != 44:
        raise RuntimeError("Original source hash changed during standardization")

    management_workbooks, summary = build_management_workbooks(
        datasets,
        rules,
        duplicate_snapshot,
        validation,
        metrics,
        runtime,
        formal_inputs,
        hash_rows,
    )
    manifest = {
        "schema_version": "stage04-artifact-manifest-v1",
        "created_at": now_iso(),
        "preview_dir": PREVIEW_DIR.as_posix(),
        "datasets": datasets,
        "management_workbooks": management_workbooks,
        "expected_workbook_count": 22,
    }
    save_json(WORK_DIR / "manifest.json", manifest)

def jsonl(path: Path, rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for row in rows:
            f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")


def dataset(
    key: str,
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    notes: str,
    warnings: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    reconciliation: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    source_info: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    path = WORK / f"{key}.jsonl"
    jsonl(path, rows)
    cols = columns_for(rows)
    return {

        "title": title,
        "output_path": str(output_path),

    v1_fill_path = S05 / "重建数据" / "05_Fill增强明细.xlsx"
    v1_order_path = S05 / "重建数据" / "05_Order实际执行汇总.xlsx"

    v1_event_path = S05 / "重建数据" / "05_仓位变化事件.xlsx"
    v1_ledger_path = S05 / "重建数据" / "05_仓位路径账本.xlsx"
    v1_process_path = S05 / "重建数据" / "05_仓位全过程汇总.xlsx"
    v1_timeline_path = S05 / "重建数据" / "05_仓位与订单统一时间线.xlsx"
    v1_fills = xlsx_rows(v1_fill_path)
    v1_orders = xlsx_rows(v1_order_path)
    v1_cycles = xlsx_rows(v1_cycle_path)
    v1_events = xlsx_rows(v1_event_path)
    v1_ledger = xlsx_rows(v1_ledger_path)
    v1_process = xlsx_rows(v1_process_path)
    v1_timeline = xlsx_rows(v1_timeline_path)
    if (len(v1_fills), len(v1_orders), len(v1_cycles)) != (8341, 372, 148):
        raise RuntimeError("阶段05_v1核心数量与冻结结论不一致")

    cross_rows, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles = cross_match_d2(rows_by_layer["D2"], v1_fills)
    if len(cross_rows) != 102 or sum(x["coverage_class"].startswith("B") for x in cross_rows) != 102:

    cycle_to_b01 = {x["position_cycle_id"]: x["b01_fill_record_ids"].split("；") for x in b01_cycles}

def audit_images() -> tuple[list[dict], dict, list[dict]]:
    records: list[dict] = []
    features: list[np.ndarray] = []
    for folder_rel, expected, prefix in [
        (CANCEL_REL, "已取消", "C"),
        (EXPIRE_REL, "已过期", "E"),
    ]:
        folder = ROOT / folder_rel
        files = sorted(p for p in folder.iterdir() if p.is_file())
        image_files = [p for p in files if p.suffix.lower() in IMAGE_EXTS]
        for sequence, path in enumerate(image_files, start=1):
            stat = path.stat()
            record = {
                "image_internal_id": f"{prefix}{sequence:03d}",
                "relative_path": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
                "absolute_path": str(path),
                "file_name": path.name,
                "folder_expected_status": expected,
                "file_size_bytes": stat.st_size,
                "mtime": iso_mtime(stat),
                "sha256": sha256_file(path),
                "readable": "否",
                "format": None,
                "width_px": None,
                "height_px": None,
                "mode": None,
                "grayscale_mean": None,
                "grayscale_stddev": None,
                "black_or_blank": "待检查",
                "severe_crop_dimension_flag": "待检查",
                "error": "",
            }
            try:
                with Image.open(path) as image:
                    image.load()
                    record["readable"] = "是"
                    record["format"] = image.format or path.suffix.lower().lstrip(".").upper()
                    record["width_px"], record["height_px"] = image.size
                    record["mode"] = image.mode
                    stat_gray = ImageStat.Stat(image.convert("L"))
                    mean = float(stat_gray.mean[0])
                    stddev = float(stat_gray.stddev[0])
                    record["grayscale_mean"] = round(mean, 4)
                    record["grayscale_stddev"] = round(stddev, 4)
                    record["black_or_blank"] = "是" if (mean < 5 or mean > 252) and stddev < 5 else "否"
                    record["severe_crop_dimension_flag"] = "否" if image.size == (1080, 2400) else "是"
                    features.append(image_feature(image))
            except Exception as exc:  # deliberate: a damaged image must be recorded, not abort the audit
                record["error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
                features.append(np.full((120, 54), np.nan, dtype=np.float32))
            records.append(record)

def workbook_rows(path: Path, sheet: str | int = 0) -> tuple[int, list[str], list[dict]]:
    workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    worksheet = workbook[workbook.sheetnames[sheet] if isinstance(sheet, int) else sheet]
    worksheet.reset_dimensions()
    raw_rows = list(worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    workbook.close()
    header_index = None
    best_nonblank = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(raw_rows[:20]):
        nonblank = sum(value is not None for value in row)
        if nonblank > best_nonblank:
            best_nonblank = nonblank
            header_index = index
    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

def write_json(path: Path, payload: object) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=json_default),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    temporary.replace(path)

            "destination_sha256": destination_hash,

    )

def read_simple_sheet(path: Path, sheet: str) -> list[dict]:
    wb = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)

    header = list(next(rows))
    result = [dict(zip(header, row)) for row in rows if any(v is not None for v in row)]
    wb.close()
    return result

def copy_verified(
    source: Path,
    destination: Path,
    copy_rows: list[dict],
    source_label: str,
) -> None:
    if not source.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(source)
    if destination.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"拒绝覆盖已存在目标：{destination}")
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
    source_size = source.stat().st_size
    destination_size = destination.stat().st_size
    source_hash = sha256_file(source)
    destination_hash = sha256_file(destination)
    matched = source_size == destination_size and source_hash == destination_hash
    copy_rows.append(
        {
            "source_label": source_label,
            "source": source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "destination": destination.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "source_size": source_size,
            "destination_size": destination_size,
            "source_sha256": source_hash,
            "destination_sha256": destination_hash,
            "matched": matched,
        }
    )
    if not matched:
        raise RuntimeError(f"字节级复制校验失败：{destination}")

def read_simple_sheet(path: Path, sheet: str) -> list[dict]:
    wb = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    ws = wb[sheet]
    rows = ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)
    header = list(next(rows))
    result = [dict(zip(header, row)) for row in rows if any(v is not None for v in row)]
    wb.close()
    return result

    result: dict[str, Any],
    artifact: dict[str, Any],
    validation: dict[str, Any],
    protection_final: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    m_counts = Counter(
        row["match_evidence_level"] for row in result["main_rows"]
    )
    one_cycle_t = sum(
        row["mapping_relation_type"] == "ONE_T_TO_ONE_CYCLE"
        for row in result["main_rows"]
    )
    multiple_cycle_t = sum(
        row["mapping_relation_type"] in ("ONE_T_TO_MANY_CYCLES", "MANY_TO_MANY")
        for row in result["main_rows"]
    )
    cycle_to_t: defaultdict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    for row in result["mapping_rows"]:
        cycle_to_t[row["position_cycle_id"]].append(
            row["manual_review_trade_id"]
        )
    multiple_t_cycles = sum(len(values) > 1 for values in cycle_to_t.values())
    report_lines = [
        "# 阶段06｜人工复盘匹配｜完成报告",
        "",
        f"生成时间：{RUN_TS}",
        "",
        "1. 阶段06是否完成：是。",
        f"2. T记录总数：{len(result['main_rows'])}。",

def workbook_rows(path: Path, sheet: str | int = 0) -> tuple[int, list[str], list[dict]]:
    workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    worksheet = workbook[workbook.sheetnames[sheet] if isinstance(sheet, int) else sheet]
    worksheet.reset_dimensions()
    raw_rows = list(worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    workbook.close()
    header_index = None
    best_nonblank = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(raw_rows[:20]):
        nonblank = sum(value is not None for value in row)
        if nonblank > best_nonblank:
            best_nonblank = nonblank
            header_index = index
    if header_index is None:
        return 0, [], []
    headers = [clean_text(value) for value in raw_rows[header_index]]
    records = []
    for row in raw_rows[header_index + 1 :]:
        if not any(value is not None for value in row):
            continue
        records.append(dict(zip(headers, row)))
    return header_index + 1, headers, records

    temporary.write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=json_default),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    temporary.replace(path)

def load_inputs(self) -> None:
        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")

def load_inputs(self) -> None:
        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")

def load_inputs(self) -> None:
        self.log("开始只读加载阶段04、05_v2、06、07及B01正式输入")
        for item in INPUTS:
            path = self.root / item.relative
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少正式输入：{path}")
            stat = path.stat()
            manifest_row = {
                "阶段": item.stage,
                "输入键": item.key,
                "相对路径": item.relative,
                "工作表": item.sheet,
                "文件大小": stat.st_size,
                "修改时间": datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                "SHA256": _sha256(path),
                "读取状态": "成功",
            }
            self.input_manifest.append(manifest_row)
            if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx":
                self.frames[item.key] = _read_excel(path, item.sheet)
            else:
                # 正式报告必须读取，但不将大段文本复制进输出。
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                if not text.strip():
                    raise ValueError(f"正式报告为空：{path}")
                self.frames[item.key] = pd.DataFrame({"content_length": [len(text)]})
        self.log(f"正式输入加载完成：{len(INPUTS)}个文件")
